name: Mimsy & Friends!
source:
It's a lovely day and you want to spend it with your girlfriend Alma, but where is she?

Mimsy & Friends is a short, cute mostly kinetic novel about a girl bringing a cake to her girlfriend.

[From [url=https://zeddybear.itch.io/mimsy-friends]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是美好的一天，你想和女朋友阿尔玛一起度过，但她在哪里？

《敏西和朋友们》是一部简短、可爱的动态小说，讲述了一个女孩给她女朋友送蛋糕的故事。

[来自[url=https://zeddybear.itch.io/mimsy-friends]itch.io[/url]]
